title_en: US Trademark Registration for Chinese Sellers: Fees, Rules and Brand Registry
title_zh: 国内卖家如何注册美国商标：官费、规则与亚马逊品牌备案
desc_en: Foreign applicants need a US attorney, USPTO fees start at $350 per class, and a pending mark can unlock Amazon Brand Registry. A practical US trademark guide.
desc_zh: 境外申请人必须委托美国律师，USPTO 官费每类 350 美元起，申请中的商标即可开通亚马逊品牌备案。本文整理美国商标申请规则、官费构成、申请步骤清单和常见错误，适合出海品牌参考。
keywords_en: how to register a trademark in the US
keywords_zh: 国内卖家注册美国商标
body_en:
A US trademark is the key that unlocks Amazon Brand Registry, protects your listings from hijackers and gives you a legal basis to act against copycats on Walmart and TikTok Shop too. For Chinese factories and brands, the process has a few extra rules that trip people up. This guide covers who can file, what it costs at the USPTO, and how to use a pending application with Amazon.

Rule 1: foreign applicants need a US attorney

Since August 3, 2019, the USPTO requires all trademark applicants and registrants whose permanent legal residence or principal place of business is outside the United States to be represented by an attorney licensed to practice law in the US. That includes companies in mainland China and Hong Kong. The attorney must stay on record for the application, responses to Office actions and later maintenance filings.

Tip: Be cautious with very cheap filing offers. Ask for the attorney's name and US bar membership, and check that the attorney actually appears on your filing.

What the USPTO charges

A new USPTO fee rule took effect on January 18, 2025. According to summaries by Gerben IP and Reed Smith, the old TEAS Plus and TEAS Standard options were replaced by a single $350 base fee per class, plus surcharges:

  • $100 per class if the application is missing required information.
  • $200 per class if you write your own description of goods instead of using terms from the USPTO's ID Manual.
  • $200 per class for each additional 1,000 characters of free-form description.

The chart shows how these add up for one class:

Gerben IP also lists later fees per class: $150 for a Statement of Use (for intent-to-use applications), $300 for the Section 8 declaration and $350 for the Section 9 renewal. These are government fees only; attorney fees are separate. Fees can change, so check the USPTO fee schedule before filing.

How Amazon Brand Registry fits in

According to Amazon's Brand Registry page, you need "an active, registered trademark or a pending trademark application" from the trademark office of a country with an Amazon store. The mark must be a word mark or a design mark containing words, letters or numbers, and the brand name on your products or packaging must match the trademark record exactly. You must be the trademark owner; an agency should be added as a user after the owner enrolls.

In practice, many sellers enroll with a pending US application and complete registration later. Amazon's IP Accelerator can also connect you with vetted law firms if you don't yet have a trademark.

Step-by-step checklist

  1. Pick a distinctive name. Invented words are easier to register than descriptive ones. Avoid names that simply describe the product ("Best Kitchen Knife").
  2. Search first. Have your attorney search the USPTO database for identical or similar marks in related classes before filing.
  3. Choose classes carefully. Each class costs another base fee. Cover what you sell now and what you realistically plan to launch.
  4. Use ID Manual terms where possible to avoid the free-form surcharges.
  5. Decide the applicant. File in the name of the entity that will own the brand and the Amazon account. Changing owners later adds cost and paperwork.
  6. Prepare specimens. For a use-based application you need proof the mark is used in US commerce, such as product or packaging photos showing the brand.
  7. Enroll in Brand Registry with the serial number once the application is filed, and keep the brand name identical everywhere.
  8. Diary the deadlines. Office action responses, Statements of Use and maintenance filings all have strict deadlines.

Common mistakes

  • Filing in a personal name while the Amazon account belongs to a company.
  • Spelling or spacing of the brand differs between the trademark, packaging and listings.
  • Filing too many classes "just in case," then paying renewal fees for all of them.
  • Letting an agent or supplier file in their own name, so they, not you, own the brand.

body_zh:
美国商标是开通亚马逊品牌备案（Brand Registry）的“钥匙”，能保护 Listing 不被跟卖，也让你在沃尔玛、TikTok Shop 上对抗仿品有了法律依据。对国内工厂和品牌来说，美国商标申请有几条特殊规则，很容易踩坑。本文讲清楚谁能申请、USPTO 官费多少，以及如何用“申请中”的商标开通亚马逊品牌备案。

规则一：境外申请人必须委托美国律师

自 2019 年 8 月 3 日起，USPTO 规定，永久居所或主要营业地在美国境外的商标申请人和注册人，必须委托具有美国执业资格的律师代理，中国大陆和香港公司都包括在内。从提交申请、答复审查意见到后续维护，律师都需要登记在案。

小提示：对价格特别低的代理报价要谨慎。请对方提供代理律师姓名和美国律师执照信息，并在申请记录上核实律师是否真实登记。

USPTO 官费是多少

USPTO 新收费规则于 2025 年 1 月 18 日生效。据 Gerben IP 和 Reed Smith 的整理，原来的 TEAS Plus 和 TEAS Standard 两档合并为每类 350 美元的基础申请费，另加附加费：

  • 申请信息不全：每类 100 美元；
  • 不使用 USPTO ID Manual 标准描述、自拟商品描述：每类 200 美元；
  • 自拟描述每多 1,000 个字符：每类再加 200 美元。

下图是单个类别下各种情况的官费叠加：

Gerben IP 还列出了后续每类官费：意图使用申请的使用声明（Statement of Use）150 美元，第 8 条使用宣誓 300 美元，第 9 条续展 350 美元。以上均为官费，不含律师费。收费可能调整，申请前请以 USPTO 官方收费表为准。

和亚马逊品牌备案的关系

根据亚马逊品牌备案官方页面，品牌需要拥有有亚马逊站点的国家商标局颁发的“有效注册商标或正在申请中的商标”。商标须为文字商标，或包含文字、字母、数字的图形商标；产品或包装上的品牌名称必须与商标记录完全一致。申请人必须是商标所有人，服务商应在品牌方完成备案后以用户身份加入。

实际操作中，很多卖家先用美国商标的申请号开通品牌备案，之后再完成注册。如果还没有商标，亚马逊的 IP Accelerator 计划也可以对接经过审核的律所。

申请步骤清单

  1. 起一个有显著性的名字：臆造词比描述性词汇更容易注册，避免直接描述产品的名字（如“Best Kitchen Knife”）。
  2. 先检索：让律师在 USPTO 数据库中检索相关类别下的相同或近似商标。
  3. 谨慎选择类别：每多一个类别就多一份基础费。覆盖现在在卖的和确定要上的产品即可。
  4. 尽量使用 ID Manual 标准描述，避免自拟描述附加费。
  5. 确定申请主体：用将来持有品牌和亚马逊账户的主体申请，后期转让既花钱又麻烦。
  6. 准备使用证据：基于使用的申请需要提供商标在美国商业中使用的证据，比如带品牌的产品或包装照片。
  7. 提交后开通品牌备案：拿到申请号即可申请品牌备案，所有地方的品牌名保持一致。
  8. 记好截止日期：审查意见答复、使用声明和维护文件都有严格期限。

常见错误

  • 用个人名义申请商标，但亚马逊账户属于公司；
  • 商标、包装和 Listing 上的品牌拼写或空格不一致；
  • “以防万一”申请太多类别，之后每个类别都要续展费；
  • 让代理或供应商以他们自己的名义申请，导致品牌不归你所有。
